summary: The details for this species have not been published yet.

population.notes: Tier A override: ~100 active territories in Kruger (BirdLife SA 2025 citing van Eeden/Murgatroyd). Kemp 2001 baseline was 128–512 mature individuals (2^8).

sources.title: BirdLife South Africa Red List — Martial Eagle (2025)

Kemp A.C., Herholdt J.J., Whyte I. & Harrison J. (2001). Birds of the two largest national parks in South Africa: a method to generate estimates of population size for all species and assess their conservation ecology. S. Afr. J. Sci. 97: 393–403.

kempBaseline.notes: Kemp et al. 2001 order-of-magnitude threshold 2^8=256 mature individuals (resident breeder); paper interval half–double → 128–512.
